tagline.en_US: Raneto - is an open source Knowledgebase platform that uses static Markdown files to power your Knowledgebase.

description.en_US: Raneto is an open-source knowledge base platform powered by static Markdown files. It provides a web interface designed for reading and editing documentation pages. It is useful for creating and maintaining lightweight knowledge bases directly from flat files without requiring a complex database setup.

tips: The web interface is only for editing Markdown files
